metadata.name: Regular Book Reading

sources.citation: Bavishi A, Slade MD, Levy BR. A chapter a day: Association of book reading with longevity. Soc Sci Med. 2016;164:44-48

metadata.description: Health and Retirement Study (n=3,635, 12-year follow-up): book readers had ~20% lower mortality than non-readers after adjustment for age, sex, education, comorbidities, self-rated health, wealth, marital status and depression (tertile HRs 0.83 and 0.77). Shares the cultural category with creative hobbies, so the combination rule attenuates overlap.
